source.stem: Which cell helps to move dust particles out of an organism?

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Adult frogs breathe through lungs and gills.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Tadpoles breathe through lungs and skin.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Every animal that breathes through gills is a tadpole.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: All animals living in water breathe through gills.

intelligence.enrichment: Different animals use different breathing mechanisms suited to their habitats; frogs change body parts for breathing across life stages, with tadpoles using gills and adult frogs using lungs and skin. habitat and life stage differ -> breathing body parts differ -> animals obtain oxygen in suited ways The learner correctly applies this rule: Different animals use different breathing mechanisms suited to their habitats; frogs change body parts for breathing across life stages, with tadpoles using gills and adult frogs using lungs and skin. Every animal breathes with lungs, no matter where it lives or what stage of life it is in.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Nutrition in animals. The student must decide: Classify animal breathing mechanisms as adaptations to habitat and life stage, such as tadpoles using gills and adult frogs using lungs and skin. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
